examples.text: bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhave, aññataro puriso imasmiṃ'y'eva rājagahe manussadaḷiddo ahosi manussakapaṇo manussavarāko. so tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye saddhaṃ samādiyi, sīlaṃ samādiyi, sutaṃ samādiyi, cāgaṃ samādiyi, paññaṃ samādiyi.

51201.meaning1: wretched human state; human misfortune; personal failure
51201.commentary: (ANa) manussadobhagyan'ti manussesu sampattirahitaṃ pañcavidhaṃ nīcakulaṃ. (KVt) manussadobhaggena vā'ti kāṇā homi, kuṇī homi, itarā vā īdisā hotū'ti-ādinā manussavirūpabhāvena.

examples.text: n'atthi samaṇassa gotamassa uttari manussadhammā alam'ariya-ñāṇadassana-viseso. takkapariyāhataṃ samaṇo gotamo dhammaṃ deseti vīmaṃs'ānucaritaṃ sayaṃpaṭibhānaṃ. yassa ca khv'āssa atthāya dhammo desito so niyyāti takkarassa sammā dukkhakkhayāyā'ti.
atthi nu kho me uttarimanussadhammā alam'ariya-ñāṇadassana-viseso adhigato, so'haṃ pacchime kāle sabrahmacārīhi puṭṭho na maṅku bhavissāmī'ti

51203.meaning1: becoming a human being; acquiring the human state

examples.text: kiccho manussapaṭilābho, kicchaṃ maccāna jīvitaṃ, kicchaṃ saddhammassavanaṃ, kiccho buddhānam'uppādo.

51204.commentary: (VINa) paṇḍakā'ti ussannakilesā avūpasantapariḷāhā napuṃsakā, te pariḷāhaveg'ābhibhūtā yena kenaci saddhiṃ mittabhāvaṃ patthenti.

51207.commentary: (NIDD1) manussaphassā vuccanti corā vā assu mānavā vā katakammā vā akatakammā vā. te bhikkhuṃ pañhaṃ vā puccheyyuṃ vādaṃ vā āropeyyuṃ akkoseyyuṃ paribhāseyyuṃ roseyyuṃ viroseyyuṃ hiṃseyyuṃ vihiṃseyyuṃ heṭheyyuṃ viheṭheyyuṃ ghāteyyuṃ upaghāteyyuṃ upaghātaṃ vā kareyyuṃ. yo koci manussato upaghāto, manussaphasso.

examples.text: pañcannaṃ dhīro bhayānaṃ na bhāye, bhikkhu sato sapariyantacārī, ḍaṃs'ādhipātānaṃ sarīsapānaṃ, manussaphassānaṃ catuppadānaṃ.

51208.commentary: (JAa) manussabhāvo ca gavaṃ'va pekkho'ti apica yo etesaṃ manussabhāvo, so gunnaṃ viya pekkhitabbo.

examples.text: sīhassa byagghassa ca dīpino ca, na vijjatī porisiyaṃbalena, manussabhāvo ca gavaṃ'va pekkho, jātī hi tesaṃ asamā samānā.

aṭṭhahi akkhaṇehi vajjitaṃ manussabhāvaṃ sandhāy'āha sudullabho laddho manussalābho'ti. tattha aṭṭha akkhaṇā nāma tayo apāyā arūpā asaññasattā paccantadeso indriyānaṃ vekallaṃ niyatamicchādiṭṭhikatā apātubhāvo buddhassā'ti.

51210.meaning1: in human form; of human birth
51210.commentary: (THa) manussabhūtan'ti manussesu bhūtaṃ, nibbattaṃ, manuss'attabhāvaṃ vā pattaṃ. (ANa) manussabhūtan'ti dev'ādibhāvaṃ anupagantvā manussam'eva bhūtaṃ.

examples.text: manussabhūtaṃ sambuddhaṃ, attadantaṃ samāhitaṃ, iriyamānaṃ brahmapathe, cittass'ūpasame rataṃ.
yam'pi bhikkhave tathāgato purimaṃ jātiṃ purimaṃ bhavaṃ purimaṃ niketaṃ pubbe manussabhūto samāno micchājīvaṃ pahāya sammāājīvena jīvikaṃ kappesi

51212.commentary: (THa) manussabhūtan'ti manussesu bhūtaṃ, nibbattaṃ, manuss'attabhāvaṃ vā pattaṃ.

examples.text: ime ce'pi, bhaddiya, mahāsālā imāya āvaṭṭaniyā āvaṭṭeyyuṃ akusaladhammappahānāya kusaladhamm'ūpasampadāya, imesam'pi'ssa mahāsālānaṃ dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya, ko pana vādo manussabhūtassā'ti!
thūṇaṃ ce'p'āhaṃ acetanaṃ vādena vādaṃ samārabheyyaṃ, sā'pi mayā vādena vādaṃ samāraddhā saṅkampeyya sampakampeyya sampavedheyya. ko pana vādo manussabhūtassā'ti?
kā ca, bhikkhave, sappurisānaṃ gati? devamahattatā vā manussamahattatā vā'ti.

51215.meaning1: king of human beings; lord of men

examples.text: dutiyam'pi saddam'anussāvesi, bimbisāro ahaṃ bhagavā, bimbisāro ahaṃ sugatā'ti. idaṃ sattamaṃ kho ahaṃ, bhante, vessavaṇassa mahārājassa sahabyataṃ upapajjāmi, so tato cuto manussarājā bhavituṃ pahomi.

51216.commentary: (SNa) manussarāmaṇeyyassā'ti manussaramaṇīyabhāvassa. idāni manussaramaṇīyakavasena bhūmiramaṇīyakaṃ dassento gāme vā'ti-ādim'āha.

examples.text: ārāmacetyā vanacetyā, pokkharañño sunimmitā, manussarāmaṇeyyassa, kalaṃ n'āgghanti soḷasiṃ.

51217.meaning1: isolated from people; secluded from humans

examples.text: veḷuvane kho'haṃ, brāhmaṇa, eta'r'ahi viharāmī'ti. kacci pana, bho ānanda, veḷuvanaṃ ramaṇīyañ'c'eva appasaddañ'ca appanigghosañ'ca vijanavātaṃ manussarāhaseyyakaṃ paṭisallānasāruppan'ti?

51218.meaning1: isolated from people; secluded from humans
51218.commentary: (MNa) manussarāhasseyyakānī'ti manussānaṃ rahassakamm'ānucchavikāni, rahassamantaṃ mantentānaṃ anurūpānī'ti attho.

examples.text: yāni ca kho tāni sen'āsanāni appasaddāni appanigghosāni vijanavātāni manussarāhasseyyakāni paṭisallānasāruppāni tathārūpehi sen'āsanehi saṃsaggaṃ vaṇṇayāmī'ti

51219.meaning1: human world; world of men; human realm
51219.commentary: (MNa) manussaloke sāvatthiyaṃ sattapaṇṇāsa kulasatasahassāni, rājagahe anto ca bahi ca aṭṭhārasa manussakoṭiyo vasiṃsu. evaṃ aññesu'pi ṭhānesū'ti manussaloke'pi gaṇavāso'va.

examples.text: katamā ca, bhikkhave, āsavānaṃ vemattatā? atthi, bhikkhave, āsavā nirayagamanīyā, atthi āsavā tiracchānayonigamanīyā, atthi āsavā pettivisayagamanīyā, atthi āsavā manussalokagamanīyā, atthi āsavā devalokagamanīyā.
loko'ti nirayaloko tiracchānaloko pettivisayaloko manussaloko devaloko khandhaloko dhātuloko āyatanaloko ayaṃ loko paro loko brahmaloko devaloko, ayaṃ vuccati loko.

51220.meaning1: which leads to the human realm; which is conducive to human rebirth

examples.text: katamā ca, bhikkhave, āsavānaṃ vemattatā? atthi, bhikkhave, āsavā nirayagamanīyā, atthi āsavā tiracchānayonigamanīyā, atthi āsavā pettivisayagamanīyā, atthi āsavā manussalokagamanīyā, atthi āsavā devalokagamanīyā.

51221.meaning1: leading to the human realm; conducive to human rebirth

examples.text: manusse c'āhaṃ, sāriputta, pajānāmi, manussalokagāmiñ'ca maggaṃ, manussalokagāminiñ'ca paṭipadaṃ, yathā paṭipanno ca kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā manussesu upapajjati tañ'ca pajānāmi.

51222.meaning1: to be experienced in the human realm

51223.meaning1: perception of people; concept of humans

examples.text: so evaṃ pajānāti, ye assu darathā gāmasaññaṃ paṭicca te'dha na santi, ye assu darathā manussasaññaṃ paṭicca te'dha na santi, atthi c'ev'āyaṃ darathamattā yadidaṃ, araññasaññaṃ paṭicca ekattan'ti.

yāvañ'c'idaṃ, bhante, bhagavā evaṃ manussagahane evaṃ manussakasaṭe evaṃ manussasāṭheyye vattamāne sattānaṃ hit'āhitaṃ jānāti. gahanañ'h'etaṃ, bhante, yadidaṃ manussā, uttānakañ'h'etaṃ, bhante, yadidaṃ pasavo.

ayañ'hi devaputto pubbe manussabhūto samāno manussadaliddo ahosi manussakapaṇo manussavarāko, so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapanno devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ sahabyataṃ. so aññe deve atirocati vaṇṇena c'eva yasasā cā'ti.

51226.commentary: (VIN 1.1.3) manussaviggaho nāma yaṃ mātukucchismiṃ paṭhamaṃ cittaṃ uppannaṃ paṭhamaṃ viññāṇaṃ pātubhūtaṃ, yāva maraṇakālā etth'antare eso manussaviggaho nāma.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu sañcicca manussaviggahaṃ jīvitā voropeyya, satthahārakaṃ v'āssa pariyeseyya, maraṇavaṇṇaṃ vā saṃvaṇṇeyya, maraṇāya vā samādapeyya

51227.meaning1: offence involving defeat related to humans

51228.meaning1: expellable offence of (killing a) human being

examples.text: manussaviggahapārājik'āpatti uttarimanussadhammapārājik'āpattiyā methunadhamma-pārājik'āpattiyā adinn'ādānapārājik'āpattiyā aññabhāgiyā.

51229.meaning1: being which has taken the form of a human female

examples.text: yakkhiyā vā petiyā vā paṇḍakena vā tiracchānagatāya vā manussaviggah'itthiyā vā saddhiṃ raho paṭicchanne āsane nisajjaṃ kappeti, āpatti dukkaṭassa. amātugāme mātugāmasaññī, āpatti dukkaṭassa.

51230.meaning1: lord of men; ruler of men

examples.text: cakkavattī ahuṃ rājā, jambumaṇḍassa issaro, muddh'āvasitto khattiyo, manuss'ādhipatī ahuṃ.

51231.construction:
manussa + asura + sakka + rakkhasa + ā
manussāsurasakkarakkhasa + ā
51231.compound: dvanda (manussā ca asurā ca sakka ca rakkhasā ca)
51231.commentary: (DNa) manuss'āsurasakkarakkhasā'ti manussā ca asurā ca sakkā ca rakkhasā ca.

examples.text: mahāyasaṃ saṃparivārayanti naṃ, sace ca pabbajjam'upeti tādiso, nekkhammachand'ābhirato vicakkhaṇo, devā manuss'āsura-sakka-rakkhasā.
antamaso tiracchānagatāya'pī'ti tiracchānagat'itthiyā'pi methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevitvā assamaṇo hoti asakyaputtiyo, pag'eva manuss'itthiyā. tena vuccati, antamaso tiracchānagatāya'pī'ti.
mātugāmo nāma manuss'itthī, na yakkhī na petī, na tiracchānagatā. antamaso tadahujātā'pi dārikā, pag'eva mahattarī.

51233.meaning1: lord of men; ruler of men; epithet of the Buddha
51233.meaning2: lord of men; ruler of men

examples.text: dev'inda-nāg'inda-nar'indapūjito, manuss'indaseṭṭhehi tath'eva pūjito, taṃ vandatha pañjalikā labhitvā, buddho have kappasatehi dullabho'ti.
dev'inda-nāg'inda-nar'inda-pūjito, manuss'indaseṭṭhehi tath'eva pūjito, taṃ vandatha pañjalikā labhitvā, buddho have kappasatehi dullabho'ti.

51235.commentary: (VINa) ubhatobyañjanā'ti itthinimittena ca purisanimittena cā'ti ubhohi byañjanehi samannāgatā.

examples.text: tisso itthiyo, manuss'itthī, amanussitthī, tiracchānagatitthī. tayo ubhatobyañjanakā, manuss'ubhatobyañjanako, amanuss'ubhatobyañjanako, tiracchānagatubhatobyañjanako. tayo paṇḍakā, manussapaṇḍako, amanussapaṇḍako, tiracchānagatapaṇḍako.
evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, appakā te sattā ye manussesu paccājāyanti. atha kho ete'y'eva bahutarā sattā ye aññatra manussehi paccājāyanti.
appakā te manussesu, ye janā pāragāmino, ath'āyaṃ itarā pajā, tīram'eva anudhāvati.

51237.commentary: (SNa) ūhacca manejā'ti ete taṇhāejāya anejā bhikkhū indakhīlaṃ ūhacca samūhanitvā catūsu disāsu appaṭihatacārikaṃ caranti.

examples.text: chetvā khīlaṃ chetvā palighaṃ, indakhīlaṃ ūhacca manejā, te caranti suddhā vimalā, cakkhumatā sudantā susunāgā'ti.

51238.commentary: (VINa) man'esikāyā'ti man'esikā vuccati manasā cintitajānanakīḷā, tāya kīḷanti.

examples.text: akkharikāya'pi kīḷanti, man'esikāya'pi kīḷanti, yathāvajjena'pi kīḷanti. hatthismim'pi sikkhanti, assasmim'pi sikkhanti, rathasmim'pi sikkhanti, dhanusmim'pi sikkhanti, tharusmim'pi sikkhanti

51239.grammar: masc, in comps, mano group, from manas
51239.notes: Mano-group nouns, while neuter in Sanskrit, are considered to be masculine by classical Pāḷi grammars such as Saddanīti. The example given is mano anicco, mano dukkho'ti. Counter-examples are amoghaṃ tapo and paramaṃ tapo.

examples.text: manopubbaṅ'gamā dhammā, manoseṭṭhā manomayā, manasā ce paduṭṭhena, bhāsati vā karoti vā, tato naṃ dukkham'anveti, cakkaṃva vahato padaṃ.
aniccadassāvī kho pan'āhaṃ, bhante, bhagavato manobhāvanīyānañ'ca bhikkhūnaṃ.

51240.commentary: (MNa) yo mano padūseyyā'ti yo bhikkhu vā bhikkhunī vā mano padūseyya, taṃ kakacena okantanaṃ n'ādhivāseyya.

examples.text: ubhatodaṇḍakena ce'pi, bhikkhave, kakacena corā ocarakā aṅgam'aṅgāni okanteyyuṃ, tatrā'pi yo mano padūseyya, na me so tena sāsanakaro.

51241.commentary: (DNa) amhākaṃ kul'ūpakattherā averā hontu abyāpajjā'ti evaṃ cintanaṃ mettaṃ manokammaṃ nāma.

examples.text: kusalaṃ idaṃ manokammaṃ sukh'udrayaṃ sukhavipākan'ti, ten'eva tvaṃ, rāhula, pītipāmojjena vihareyyāsi ahoratt'ānusikkhī kusalesu dhammesu.
idha, bhikkhave, pāpabhikkhu visamena kāyakammena samannāgato hoti, visamena vacīkammena samannāgato hoti, visamena manokammena samannāgato hoti.

tatra, bhikkhave, tividhā kāyakamm'antasandosabyāpatti akusalasañcetanikā dukkh'udrayā dukkhavipākā hoti, catubbidhā vacīkamm'antasandosabyāpatti akusalasañcetanikā dukkh'udrayā dukkhavipākā hoti, tividhā manokamm'antasandosabyāpatti akusalasañcetanikā dukkh'udrayā dukkhavipākā hoti.

51243.meaning1: defect of mind; imperfection of mental conduct

examples.text: eta'r'ahi kho pan'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, arahaṃ sammāsambuddho kusalo kāyavaṅkānaṃ kāyadosānaṃ kāyakasāvānaṃ, kusalo vacīvaṅkānaṃ vacīdosānaṃ vacīkasāvānaṃ, kusalo manovaṅkānaṃ manodosānaṃ manokasāvānaṃ.
pañca kāmaguṇā loke, manochaṭṭhā paveditā, ettha chandaṃ virājetvā, evaṃ dukkhā pamuccatī'ti.

51248.commentary: (MNa) kāyadaṇḍaṃ vacīdaṇḍaṃ manodaṇḍan'ti ettha purimadaṇḍadvayaṃ te acittakaṃ payyapenti. yathā kira vāte vāyante sākhā calati, udakaṃ calati, na ca tattha cittaṃ atthi, evaṃ kāyadaṇḍo'pi acittako'va hoti. yathā ca vāte vāyante tālapaṇṇ'ādīni saddaṃ karonti, udakāni saddaṃ karonti, na ca tattha cittaṃ atthi, evaṃ vacīdaṇḍo'pi acittako'va hotī'ti imaṃ daṇḍadvayaṃ acittakaṃ paññapenti. cittaṃ pana manodaṇḍan'ti paññapenti.

examples.text: tīṇi kho, āvuso gotama, nigaṇṭho nāṭaputto daṇḍāni paññapeti pāpassa kammassa kiriyāya pāpassa kammassa pavattiyāti, seyyath'idaṃ, kāyadaṇḍaṃ, vacīdaṇḍaṃ, manodaṇḍan'ti.
manopakopaṃ rakkheyya, manasā saṃvuto siyā, manoduccaritaṃ hitvā, manasā sucaritaṃ care.
idha, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako hirīmā hoti, hirīyati kāyaduccaritena vacīduccaritena manoduccaritena, hirīyati pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā. idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, hirīdhanaṃ

51250.meaning1: who has the quality of unethical thought; who mentally misbehaves

examples.text: aṭṭhānam'etaṃ anavakāso yaṃ manoduccaritasamaṅgī taṃnidānā tappaccayā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjeyya, n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjatī'ti pajānāti

51251.meaning1: fault of mind; defect of mental conduct

examples.text: eta'r'ahi kho pan'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, arahaṃ sammāsambuddho kusalo kāyavaṅkānaṃ kāyadosānaṃ kāyakasāvānaṃ, kusalo vacīvaṅkānaṃ vacīdosānaṃ vacīkasāvānaṃ, kusalo manovaṅkānaṃ manodosānaṃ manokasāvānaṃ.
manodvāre pana ek'ekasmim'pi vikappe ek'ūnatiṃsa katvā satañ'ca soḷasa ca honti. iti sabbā'pi tīsu dvāresu dve satāni chasattati ca cetanā.

51254.meaning1: feeling related to the mind door

51255.commentary: (SNa) cakkhudhātū'ti-ādīsu… tisso manodhātuyo manodhātu, vedan'ādayo tayo khandhā sukhumarūpāni nibbānañ'ca dhammadhātu, sabbam'pi manoviññāṇaṃ manoviññāṇadhātū'ti.

examples.text: evaṃ, bhante. idaṃ kho, gahapati, dhātunānattaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatā, cakkhudhātu, rūpadhātu, cakkhuviññāṇadhātu… manodhātu, dhammadhātu, manoviññāṇadhātu.
evañ'hi te, gahapati, sikkhitabbaṃ. tasmā't'iha te, gahapati, evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ, na manaṃ upādiyissāmi, na ca me manonissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatī'ti. evañ'hi te, gahapati, sikkhitabbaṃ.
sattiyā phusati c'eva, jaṭā manonivāraṇā, arahantena pajjoto, sarā mahaddhanena ca, sataṃ saddhammam'aññāya, seyyo hoti na pāpiyo'ti.

51259.meaning1: mental agitation; mental irritation; mental disturbance

examples.text: manopakopaṃ rakkheyya, manasā saṃvuto siyā, manoduccaritaṃ hitvā, manasā sucaritaṃ care.

51260.commentary: (MNa) manopaṭibaddho'ti yasmā manamhi paṭibaddho hutvā kālaṅ'karoti, tasmā manosattesu devesu upapajjatī'ti dasseti.

examples.text: asu hi, bhante, manopaṭibaddho kālaṅ'karotī'ti.

51261.meaning1: heart's aspiration; mind's resolve; mental determination
51261.commentary: (DNt) manopaṇidhī'ti manasā eva patthanā, tathā cittappavattimattam'evā'ti attho

examples.text: mamañ'hi pubbe etadahosi, aho vata aññe'pi sattā itthattaṃ āgaccheyyun'ti. iti mama ca manopaṇidhi, ime ca sattā itthattaṃ āgatā'ti.
samānabhāgaṃ kubbetha, gāme akkuṭṭhavanditaṃ, manopadosaṃ rakkheyya, santo anuṇṇato care.
sutaṃ m'etaṃ, bhante, isīnaṃ manopadosena taṃ daṇḍakī'raññaṃ kāliṅg'āraññaṃ majjh'āraññaṃ mātaṅg'āraññaṃ araññaṃ araññabhūtan'ti.

51263.meaning1: mental corruption; dirt in the mind

examples.text: samānabhāgaṃ kubbetha, gāme akkuṭṭhavanditaṃ, manopadosaṃ rakkheyya, santo anuṇṇato care.

51264.meaning1: mentally corrupted; epithet of a class of envious devas

examples.text: ye pana mayaṃ ahumhā manopadosikā, te mayaṃ ativelaṃ aññam'aññaṃ upanijjhāyimhā. te mayaṃ ativelaṃ aññam'aññaṃ upanijjhāyantā aññam'aññamhi cittāni padūsimhā, te mayaṃ aññam'aññaṃ paduṭṭhacittā kilantakāyā kilantacittā.

51265.meaning1: name of a group of deities

examples.text: santi, bhikkhave, manopadosikā nāma devā, te ativelaṃ aññam'aññaṃ upanijjhāyanti. te ativelaṃ aññam'aññaṃ upanijjhāyantā aññam'aññamhi cittāni padūsenti.

51267.commentary: (MNa) manopavicārā'ti vitakkavicārā. vitakkuppādakañhi mano idha mano'ti adhippetaṃ, manassa upavicārāti manopavicārā.

examples.text: cha ajjhattikāni āyatanāni veditabbāni, cha bāhirāni āyatanāni veditabbāni, cha viññāṇakāyā veditabbā, cha phassakāyā veditabbā, aṭṭhārasa mano'pavicārā veditabbā, chattiṃsa sattapadā veditabbā

aṭṭhārasamano'pavicāro ayaṃ, bhikkhu, puriso'ti, iti kho pan'etaṃ vuttaṃ. kiñ'c'etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ? cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā somanassaṭṭhānīyaṃ rūpaṃ upavicarati, domanassaṭṭhānīyaṃ rūpaṃ upavicarati, upekkhāṭṭhānīyaṃ rūpaṃ upavicarati.

51268.meaning1: led by mind; preceded by mind; headed by mind; with mind as forerunner
51268.commentary: (DHPa) dhammā'ti vedan'ādayo tayo khandhā. ete hi uppādapaccay'aṭṭhena somanassasampayuttamano pubbaṅ'gamo etesan'ti manopubbaṅ'gamā nāma.

examples.text: manopubbaṅ'gamā dhammā, manoseṭṭhā manomayā, manasā ce paduṭṭhena, bhāsati vā karoti vā, tato naṃ dukkham'anveti, cakkaṃva vahato padaṃ.

51269.meaning1: who are worthy of respect; worthy of esteem
51269.meaningLit: who should be developed in mind
51269.commentary: (DNt) mano bhavanti manaso vivaṭṭanissitaṃ vaḍḍhiṃ āvahantī'ti manobhāvaniyā'ti

examples.text: atha kho pañcak'aṅgassa thapatissa etadahosi, akālo kho tāva bhagavantaṃ dassanāya, paṭisallīno bhagavā. manobhāvaniyānam'pi bhikkhūnaṃ asamayo dassanāya, paṭisallīnā manobhāvaniyā bhikkhū.

51270.meaning1: who are worthy of respect; worthy of esteem
51270.meaningLit: who should be developed in mind
51270.commentary: (SNa) manobhāvanīyānan'ti manavaḍḍhakānaṃ. yesu hi diṭṭhesu kusalavasena cittaṃ vaḍḍhati, te sāriputtamoggallān'ādayo mahātherā manobhāvanīyā nāma.

examples.text: aniccadassāvī kho pan'āhaṃ, bhante, bhagavato manobhāvanīyānañ'ca bhikkhūnaṃ.
so khv'āhaṃ, bhante, bhagavantaṃ vā payirupāsitvā manobhāvanīye vā bhikkhū sāy'anhasamayaṃ kapilavatthuṃ pavisanto, bhantena'pi hatthinā samāgacchāmi, bhantena'pi assena samāgacchāmi
manopubbaṅ'gamā dhammā, manoseṭṭhā manomayā, manasā ce paduṭṭhena, bhāsati vā karoti vā, tato naṃ dukkham'anveti, cakkaṃva vahato padaṃ.
papañcasaññā itar'ītarā narā, papañcayantā upayanti saññino, manomayaṃ gehasitañ'ca sabbaṃ, panujja nekkhammasitaṃ irīyati.

51272.meaning1: name of a privately awakened Buddha

examples.text: satthā pavattā sarabhaṅgo lomahaṃso, ucc'aṅgamāyo asito anāsavo, manomayo mānacchido ca bandhumā, tadādhimutto vimalo ca ketumā.

51273.meaning1: knowledge of the psychic power of mentally producing a body
51273.meaning2: knowledge of the supernormal power of mental creation
51273.commentary: (PM) katamā manomayā iddhi? idha bhikkhu imamhā kāyā aññaṃ kāyaṃ abhinimmināti rūpiṃ manomayaṃ sabb'aṅgapaccaṅgiṃ ahīn'indriyaṃ.

examples.text: tato paṭipāṭiyāva samādhi paññā vimutti vimuttiñāṇadassanaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ… ākās'ānañc'āyatanasamāpatti… vipassanāñāṇaṃ manomayiddhiñāṇaṃ iddhividhañāṇaṃ dibbasotañāṇaṃ cetopariyañāṇaṃ pubbenivās'ānussatiñāṇaṃ dibbacakkhuñāṇaṃ…

51274.commentary: (DNa) katamaṃ manomoneyyaṃ? tividhamanoduccaritassa pahānaṃ manomoneyyaṃ, tividhaṃ manosucaritaṃ manomoneyyaṃ, man'ārammaṇe ñāṇaṃ manomoneyyaṃ, manopariññā manomoneyyaṃ. pariññāsahagato maggo, manasmiṃ chandarāgappahānaṃ, cittasaṅkhāranirodhā saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpatti manomoneyyan'ti (mahāni. 14).

examples.text: tīṇi moneyyāni, kāyamoneyyaṃ, vacīmoneyyaṃ, manomoneyyaṃ.

51275.meaning1: heart's desire; object of interest; wish

examples.text: sabbattha sukhito hutvā, saṃsaritvā bhav'ābhave, anāgatamhi addhāne, lacchase taṃ manorathaṃ.

51276.meaning1: commentary on the Aṅguttara Nikāya compiled by Buddhaghosa

examples.text: yathā saṅkāraṭhānasmiṃ, ujjhitasmiṃ mahāpathe, padumaṃ tattha jāyetha, sucigandhaṃ manoramaṃ.
dhī taṃ jammi jare atthu, dubbaṇṇakaraṇī jare, tāva manoramaṃ bimbaṃ, jarāya abhimadditaṃ.

51278.meaning2: delightful language; Magadha language; Pāḷi language

51279.meaning1: intention which results in mental action
51279.commentary: (MNa) ubhayacopanaṃ appattā raho cintayantassa manodvāre pavattā manosaṅkhāro nāma.

examples.text: katamañ'ca, puṇṇa, kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ kaṇhavipākaṃ? idha, puṇṇa, ekacco sabyābajjhaṃ kāyasaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti, sabyābajjhaṃ vacīsaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti, sabyābajjhaṃ manosaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti.

51280.meaning1: mental intention; mental volition; mental will

examples.text: kabaḷīkāro āhāro oḷāriko vā sukhumo vā, phasso dutiyo, manosañcetanā tatiyā, viññāṇaṃ catutthaṃ
tattha katamo kāyasaṅkhāro? kāyasañcetanā kāyasaṅkhāro, vacīsañcetanā vacīsaṅkhāro, manosañcetanā cittasaṅkhāro.

51281.meaning1: sustenance that is mental intention; nutriment of mental volition
51281.commentary: (VISMa) ekādasahi aggīhi sabbaso ādittā bhavā aṅgārakāsusadisāti passato upapattibhayaṃ na hotī'ti āha manosañcetan'āhāro aṅgārakās'ūpamena dīpetabbo'ti.

examples.text: evañ'hi, bhikkhave, tassa purisassa hoti, imaṃ c'āhaṃ aṅgārakāsuṃ papatissāmi, tatonidānaṃ maraṇaṃ vā nigacchāmi maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhan'ti. evam'eva khv'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, manosañcetan'āhāro daṭṭhabbo'ti vadāmi. manosañcetanāya, bhikkhave, āhāre pariññāte tisso taṇhā pariññātā honti.

51282.meaning1: due to mental intention; caused by mental volition

examples.text: vācāya vā h'ānanda, sati vacīsañcetanāhetu uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ. mane vā h'ānanda, sati manosañcetanāhetu uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ avijjāpaccayā ca.

51283.meaning1: epithet of a class of devas in Jain doctrine
51283.commentary: (MNa) manosattā nāma devā'ti manamhi sattā laggā lagitā.

examples.text: atthi, bhante, manosattā nāma devā tattha so upapajjati.

51285.commentary: (MNa) manosamācāre yo bhikkhu abhijjhālu byāpannacitto micchādiṭṭhiko hoti, tassa manosamācāro aparisuddho nāma.

examples.text: parisuddho no manosamācāro bhavissati uttāno vivaṭo na ca chiddavā saṃvuto ca
taṃ kiṃ maññasi, vappa, ye manosamārambhapaccayā uppajjanti āsavā vighātapariḷāhā, manosamārambhā paṭiviratassa evaṃ'sa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti.

51287.grammar: ind, adv, comp, abl sg of manosamārambhapaccaya
51287.meaning1: due to mental exertion; due to initiating mental action
51287.construction:
mano + samārambha + paccaya + ā
manosamārambhapaccaya + ā

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, vappa, ye manosamārambhapaccayā uppajjanti āsavā vighātapariḷāhā, manosamārambhā paṭiviratassa evaṃ'sa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti.
yo taṃ dhammamayaṃ vegaṃ sahati, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, atari manosamuddaṃ saūmiṃ sāvaṭṭaṃ sagāhaṃ sarakkhasaṃ, tiṇṇo pāraṅ'gato thale tiṭṭhati brāhmaṇo'ti.

51289.meaning1: contact with the mind; mental impression; mental experience
51289.commentary: (DNa) manosamphasso'ti ime dasa samphasse ṭhapetvā seso sabbo manosamphasso nāma. vedanāchakkam'pi eten'eva nayena veditabbaṃ. (MNa) manosamphasso'ti iminā sesā bāvīsati lokiyavipāka-manasampayutta-phassā. (SNa) manosamphasso'ti sāvajjanena bhav'aṅgena sampayuttaphasso.

examples.text: katamo ca, bhikkhave, phasso? cha'y'ime, bhikkhave, phassakāyā, cakkhusamphasso, sotasamphasso, ghānasamphasso, jivhāsamphasso, kāyasamphasso, manosamphasso. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, phasso.
cakkhusamphasso… sotasamphasso… ghānasamphasso… jivhāsamphasso… kāyasamphasso… manosamphasso loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, etth'esā taṇhā uppajjamānā uppajjati, ettha nivisamānā nivisati

51290.meaning1: caused by mental contact; produced by mental impression; born from mental experience

examples.text: katamañ'ca, bhikkhave, domanassaṃ? yaṃ kho, bhikkhave, cetasikaṃ dukkhaṃ cetasikaṃ asātaṃ manosamphassajaṃ dukkhaṃ asātaṃ vedayitaṃ, idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, domanassaṃ
cha'y'ime, bhikkhave, vedanākāyā, cakkhusamphassajā vedanā, sotasamphassajā vedanā, ghānasamphassajā vedanā, kāyasamphassajā vedanā, manosamphassajā vedanā.

51291.meaning1: feeling arisen from a mental impressions

51292.meaning1: dependent on feeling tone arisen from mental experience

examples.text: evañ'hi te, gahapati, sikkhitabbaṃ. tasmā't'iha te, gahapati, evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ, na manosamphassajaṃ vedanaṃ upādiyissāmi, na ca me manosamphassajāvedanānissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatī'ti. evañ'hi te, gahapati, sikkhitabbaṃ.

evañ'hi te, gahapati, sikkhitabbaṃ. tasmā't'iha te, gahapati, evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ, na manosamphassaṃ upādiyissāmi, na ca me manosamphassanissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatī'ti. evañ'hi te, gahapati, sikkhitabbaṃ.

51294.grammar: ind, adv, comp, abl sg of manosamphassapaccaya
51294.meaning1: dependent on contact with the mind; due to mental impression
51294.construction:
mano + samphassa + paccaya + ā
manosamphassapaccaya + ā

examples.text: manaṃ aññato passati, dhamme aññato passati, manoviññāṇaṃ aññato passati, manosamphassaṃ aññato passati, yam'p'idaṃ manosamphassapaccayā
kāyasmiṃ sati kāyasamphassapaccayā uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhaṃ dukkhaṃ. manasmiṃ sati manosamphassapaccayā

51295.meaning1: mental experience and the corresponding field of consciousness; mental impression and the associated dimension of knowing
51295.commentary: (SNa) cakkhusamphassa-viññāṇ'āyatanan'ti cakkhuviññāṇena sampayutto cakkhusamphasso'pi viññāṇ'āyatanam'pi mam'evā'ti. ettha ca cakkhusamphassena viññāṇasampayuttakā dhammā gahitā, viññāṇ'āyatanena sabbāni'pi cakkhudvāre uppannāni āvajjan'ādiviññāṇāni. sotadvār'ādīsu'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: kuhiṃ me, samaṇa, gantvā mokkhasi? mam'eva, samaṇa, sotaṃ, mama saddā … mam'eva, samaṇa, ghānaṃ, mama gandhā, mam'eva, samaṇa, jivhā, mama rasā, mam'eva, samaṇa, kāyo, mama phoṭṭhabbā, mam'eva, samaṇa, mano, mama dhammā, mama manosamphassa-viññāṇ'āyatanaṃ. kuhiṃ me, samaṇa, gantvā mokkhasī'ti?

cakkhusamphass'āyatanaṃ, sotasamphass'āyatanaṃ, ghānasamphass'āyatanaṃ, jivhāsamphass'āyatanaṃ, kāyasamphass'āyatanaṃ, manosamphass'āyatanaṃ. chaphass'āyatano ayaṃ, bhikkhu, puriso'ti, iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ, idam'etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
aho vata ayam'āyasmā kāyaduccaritaṃ pahāya kāyasucaritaṃ bhāveyya, vacīduccaritaṃ pahāya vacīsucaritaṃ bhāveyya, manoduccaritaṃ pahāya manosucaritaṃ bhāveyya!
ime vā pana bhonto sattā kāyasucaritena samannāgatā vacīsucaritena samannāgatā manosucaritena samannāgatā ariyānaṃ anupavādakā sammādiṭṭhikā sammādiṭṭhikammasamādānā

51299.meaning1: who has the quality of ethical thought; endowed with the quality of virtuous mental behaviour

examples.text: ṭhānañ'ca kho etaṃ vijjati yaṃ manosucaritasamaṅgī taṃnidānā tappaccayā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjeyya, ṭhānam'etaṃ vijjatī'ti pajānāti. ettāvatā kho, ānanda, ṭhān'āṭhānakusalo bhikkhū'ti alaṃ vacanāyā'ti.
